text:
camila_reyes: Hi everyone! I’m Camila — joining Product as a PM, starting today. My timezone is PST. Quick q: who should I ping for laptop/MDM enrollment and VPN access? Also excited to meet y’all. Fun fact: I make terrible but enthusiastic latte art ☕

tara_ng: Welcome Camila!! 🎉 So happy to have you. Ping @ben_crane for MDM/laptop. I’ll add you to the product sync invites. Lunch on Friday? 🍣

ben_crane: hey @camila_reyes — I’ll send the MDM invite in a few mins. Can you confirm your preferred laptop (macbook air/pro)? Also, expect an Okta invite.

devex-bot: Welcome to Redwood! New-hire checklist: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding-guide — MDM, Slack, Okta, payroll.

camila_reyes: Thanks @ben_crane! MacBook Pro please. Also — who do I grab a desk key from if I ever come into the SF office?

ben_crane: noted. @tara_ng will loop facilities for the key. For VPN, @joel_park can share a quick setup.

joel_park: Hey Camila — welcome! For VPN use our WireGuard profile.

joel_park: ```
1) Install wireguard: https://www.wireguard.com/install/
2) Add profile from https://vpn.redwood.example.com/profile/camila
3) Start wg-quick up redwood-camila
```

joel_park: If you run into permission issues, DM me and I’ll sort a temporary fallback.

leah_io: welcome Camila! love the latte art fact — I do watercolor on weekends. Happy to pair on roadmap stuff next week.

camila_reyes: Awesome — thanks everyone. I got the MDM invite and Okta link. pinging here when I’m fully set up. :party_parrot:

tara_ng: 🎉 quick checklist: 1) confirm laptop arrival 2) calendar invites 3) access to product repo (will request) 4) 1:1 scheduled — done.

camila_reyes: All set for now. Appreciate the warm welcome — excited to dive in :)
